consent.label: Cookie consent
consent.title: We value your privacy
consent.text: We use cookies and similar tools to run this site, to understand how it is used and to show you relevant ads. Choose what you allow.
consent.necessaryHelp: Needed for the site to work. Always on.
consent.analyticsHelp: Helps us understand how visitors use the site.
consent.marketingHelp: Lets us and our partners show you relevant ads.
notice.label: Announcement
seo.check.robots_txt.title: robots.txt is reachable
seo.check.robots_txt.fix: Serve a robots.txt at the root of your site. With robots and verification on, your server can answer /robots.txt with what Growth's GET /v1/robots.txt gives (see the docs).
seo.check.robots_blocks.title: robots.txt lets search engines in
seo.check.robots_blocks.fix: Your robots.txt blocks every crawler from the whole site (User-agent: * with Disallow: /). Remove that line, or name only the paths you want hidden, then ask Search Console to crawl again.
seo.check.sitemap.title: A sitemap is reachable
seo.check.sitemap.fix: Publish a sitemap (Ecommerce serves one) and list it in robots.txt with a Sitemap line (the sitemaps of robots and verification), then submit it in Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.
seo.check.verification.title: Search engine verification
seo.check.verification.fix: Add your site in Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools or Yandex Webmaster, choose the HTML tag method, paste the tag's content into the robots and verification settings and include Growth's verification tags in your page head.
seo.check.reachable.title: The page opens
seo.check.reachable.fix: The page answered {status}. Make sure it exists, answers 200 and does not send visitors to another site.
seo.check.noindex.title: The page can be indexed
seo.check.noindex.fix: The page says noindex (a robots meta tag or an X-Robots-Tag header). Remove it if the page should appear in search results.
seo.check.title.title: Page title
seo.check.title.fix: Give every page its own title of about 10 to 60 characters that says what the page is (now {length}).
seo.check.description.title: Meta description
seo.check.description.fix: Add a meta description of about 50 to 160 characters that sums up the page (now {length}).
seo.check.h1.title: One main heading
seo.check.h1.fix: Use exactly one h1 heading per page with the page's main topic (now {count}).
seo.check.canonical.title: Canonical address
seo.check.canonical.fix: Add a canonical link with the page's preferred address on this website, so copies of the page are not counted twice.
seo.check.lang.title: Page language
seo.check.lang.fix: Set the page's language on its html tag, for example lang="en".
seo.check.viewport.title: Fits phones
seo.check.viewport.fix: Add the viewport meta tag (width=device-width, initial-scale=1) so the page fits phone screens.
seo.check.social.title: Social sharing tags
seo.check.social.fix: Add the og:title and og:image meta tags so shared links show a title and a picture.
seo.check.image_alt.title: Image descriptions
seo.check.image_alt.fix: Give every image an alt text that describes it ({count} have none); use an empty alt for decorative images.
seo.check.structured_data.title: Structured data
seo.check.structured_data.fix: Add JSON-LD structured data (for example Organization, Product or BreadcrumbList) in a script of type application/ld+json.
analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.timeZone: Days are in the {timeZone} time zone.
analytics.empty: Nothing recorded in these days yet.
analytics.liveHelp: Seen in the last 5 minutes, on these pages:
analytics.liveNone: Nobody has been on the site in the last 5 minutes.
analytics.trafficHelp: What visitors look at, where they come from and what they use.
analytics.funnelHelp: From viewing an item to buying it.
analytics.searchesHelp: What visitors look for, and the pages they cannot find.
analytics.vitalsHelp: How fast and steady pages are for real visitors.
analytics.journeysHelp: The latest visits of these days, step by step.
analytics.noJourneys: No visits in these days yet.
analytics.eventsHelp: Every recorded event, newest first; kept {months} months.
analytics.problem.range: Pick a first day on or before the last day, at most 366 days apart.
seo.title: SEO checklist
seo.notRun: Not checked yet: press Check my pages.
seo.pagesHelp: Paths on your website, one per line; the home page is always checked, at most 20 pages.
seo.problem.paths: Check at most 20 pages at a time.
seo.problem.rate_limited: The checklist runs at most 10 times an hour. Try again later.
indexnow.title: IndexNow
indexnow.help: New or changed pages of this website, one address per line. Search engines that take IndexNow (Bing, Yandex and others) hear about them at once.
indexnow.keyAt: Your site must serve your key at {url}.
indexnow.noKey: Set your IndexNow key in Settings first.
indexnow.badPath: The key file address in Settings is not a path on your website.
indexnow.problem.urls: Send 1 to 10,000 addresses, each an https address of this website.
indexnow.problem.rate_limited: At most 10 submissions an hour. Try again later.
indexnow.refused.key: IndexNow did not accept the key. Your site must serve it at the key file address.
indexnow.refused.host: IndexNow says the addresses do not match the key's website.
indexnow.refused.busy: IndexNow asks for fewer submissions. Try again later.
indexnow.refused.other: IndexNow did not take them. Try again later.
problem.forbidden: You do not have the permission for this.
problem.feature_off: This feature is switched off for this website.
problem.database_not_connected: Connect the website's database first (Growth dashboard → Connections).
problem.product_unavailable: Growth is not available for this website right now.
problem.rate_limited: Too many requests at once. Try again in a minute.
